body.name: G_sens
body.space: finite sets of score-law and smoothness specifications
body.def: \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{sens}}\) is a prespecified finite collection of pairs \(\bigl((\mu_{dj})_{d,j},(M_0,M_1)\bigr)\) constructed by the protocol in \(\mathrm{def:application-sensitivity-protocol}\).
body.role: Prevents a sign conclusion from resting on one unreported score-law or smoothness choice.
